title: foe configuration
description: The configuration document of one episode. docs/config.md specifies every key; this schema mirrors it. Every path is absolute. No value is read from the environment.

version.description: The configuration format version. This schema describes version 2.

name.description: A short name for the program. Shown in the viewer and written into the log. Participates in identity.

model.description: When present, foe calls the model itself. When absent, the host process answers model requests over the protocol. Every key other than provider, model, and max_output_tokens is a provider-specific option with a string value; docs/models.md lists them per provider. Does not participate in identity.

provider.description: A provider name known to the build, such as anthropic, openai, openai-compatible, openrouter, openai-codex, vertex, or exec. foe plan reports an unknown name.

model.description: The model identifier the provider expects.

max_output_tokens.description: Per-request output limit; the default is the provider's.

api_key_file.description: Absolute path to the API key file; the default is ~/.config/foe/credentials/<provider>.json.

token_file.description: Absolute path to the OAuth token file; the default is ~/.config/foe/credentials/<provider>.json.

credentials_file.description: Absolute path to Google credentials; the default is named by ~/.config/foe/credentials/vertex.json.

exec.description: Absolute path of the program an exec provider runs.

sandbox.description: Behavior when Landlock is unavailable. The rules themselves are compiled from grants and tool_defs. Does not participate in identity.

task.description: What this episode is to do. Written into the log as the first inbox item. Does not participate in identity.

instructions.description: Section key to section text. Sections render into the system prompt in lexicographic order of their keys. Key and text participate in identity.

tools.description: Names of the tools the model may call, in the order their schemas are sent to the model. Each name resolves against the built-in tools, then tool_defs, then host_tools. The order participates in identity.

tool_defs.description: Tool name to the executable it runs. Declaring an entry is what permits the episode to execute that file. The executable is hashed into identity by content.

description.description: What the tool does and how to call it; sent to the model in the tool schema.

instruction.description: When to use it; appended to the system prompt.

network.description: Whether the executable may open TCP connections.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory; the default is the first read root.

host_tools.description: Tool name to the specification of a tool the host process implements and answers over the protocol. The specification is in the document so that identity is computable from the document alone.

description.description: Sent to the model in the tool schema.

params.description: JSON Schema for the arguments, in the subset docs/config.md lists.

grants.description: What the episode may reach. Paths are absolute directory prefixes, opened once at episode start; every read and write resolves under the open directory. The kinds present and the count of each participate in identity; the paths do not.

read.description: Absolute directories the episode may read.

write.description: Absolute directories the episode may write.

execute.description: Absolute files or directories that subprocesses may read and execute.

spawn.description: Names from programs the episode may start.

budget.description: Limits for this episode and the whole tree below it. A child's budget is reserved from its parent's remainder.

input_tokens.description: Maximum provider-reported input tokens across all requests, including cache-read input; unlimited when absent.

output_tokens.description: Maximum provider-reported output tokens across all requests, including reasoning when the provider includes it; unlimited when absent.

seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the episode; unlimited when absent.

max_depth.description: How many levels of child episodes may exist below this one; 0 forbids spawning.

max_episodes.description: Lifetime count of episodes in the tree, including this one.

loop_threshold.description: Consecutive identical tool calls, or identical assistant turns, that end the episode as blocked.

done_when.description: When the episode is complete. When absent, the episode completes when the model produces a turn with no tool calls. verify and returns may both be present; the verifier then checks the returned value.

verify.description: Name of a tool in tools; the episode completes when the model finishes and this tool returns no findings.

retries.description: How many times findings are fed back.

returns.description: A JSON Schema in the subset docs/config.md lists; the episode completes when the model calls the synthesized return tool with a conforming value.

context.description: Whether and when the conversation is compacted: the oldest steps replaced in the model's context by a summary and the runtime's continuation state. docs/compaction.md specifies it. Participates in identity.

compact.description: Whether the runtime compacts the conversation when the projected next request outgrows the model's window.

window_tokens.description: The model's context window in tokens. Required when compact is true and the provider table does not know the model; must exceed reserve_tokens plus keep_recent_tokens.

reserve_tokens.description: Tokens kept free below the window; compaction runs when the projected request exceeds window_tokens minus reserve_tokens.

keep_recent_tokens.description: Approximate size of the most recent steps kept verbatim after a compaction.

margin_tokens.description: Added to the projection of the next request to absorb estimation error.

programs.description: Program name to a child configuration. A name listed in grants.spawn must appear here. A child's grants must be a subset of its parent's. Each child program's identity participates in the parent's.

child_program.description: A full configuration without version, task, model, or sandbox, which are inherited from the parent.

workflow.description: A declared graph of nodes that replaces the free loop for this episode. docs/workflow.md specifies it. The episode's tools, grants, budget, and done_when are the ceiling every node draws from. A graph whose possible firings exceed 4096 is refused at construction.

nodes.description: Node name to node. Exactly one of tool, model, and workflow is set per node.

enabled.description: Whether a node failure is put to a recovery decision; when false, a failure ends the episode with the node's outcome.

tool.description: A tool in tools; the node is one call to it.

args.description: The argument object of a tool node. A value { "$node": NAME, "pointer": POINTER } is replaced by an input node's output, or the value at a JSON Pointer within it.

follows.description: Nodes whose outputs this node receives.

followed_by.description: The same edges written from the other end.

verify.description: A tool in tools run on the node's output; findings re-fire the node.

retries.description: How many times verify findings re-fire the node.

branches.description: Label to the successors that fire when the node's value names that label in its branch field.

max_fires.description: How many times the node may fire in one episode; required on a cycle, and summed into the graph's possible firings.

terminal.description: Completing this node completes the workflow.

empty.description: The value the node contributes when recovery skips it; without it, skip is not offered.

follows.description: Further nodes whose outputs the node's recovery decision sees.
